fields.label: Admin email
fields.description: Email of the first administrator (press Enter to skip).

validators.message: must be a valid email address

fields.label: Admin tenant
fields.description: Tenant that owns the first administrator (press Enter to use the gateway default).

validators.message: must be 2-40 lowercase letters, digits or dashes

fields.label: Admin password
fields.description: Password of the first administrator. Input is hidden; press Enter to skip and set it later with `kb auth reset-admin`.

fields.label: Session signing secret
fields.description: Signs login sessions. Input is hidden; press Enter to generate a random one (recommended).
